hooks.name: Run Tests After Task
hooks.description: Runs the test suite when a spec task is marked complete. REPLACE the command with your test runner before enabling.

action.command: echo 'test-after-task is not configured yet. Edit .kiro/hooks/test-after-task.json and replace this command with your test runner, for example: pytest -q | npm test -- --run | dotnet test' >&2; exit 1
